title: THE DIVINE ORCHESTRATION AND PURPOSE OF THE PEOPLE YOU ENCOUNTER

sense.text:
“And that, knowing the time”: this is what we are supposed to be doing. We are supposed to know what time it is, not playing games. “That now it is high time to awake out of sleep”: you see what’s happening, but we are busy sensationalizing what’s on the news, the strikes on Iran, the new supreme leader, the oil, while we allow our spirits to stay rotten. Scripture says watch as well as pray, so we watch to know what’s going on. But you worrying about the bombs overseas, the damn bomb will come hit you in your damn head because you wicked as hell. Get yourselves right.

“For now is our salvation nearer than when we believed.” Our salvation is right around the corner, and here we are still playing games, entertaining sin, entertaining evil. It is a few, not many, thank the Lord, but those few should let this pierce their spirit.

As Deacon Yeshua put it: prophecy should move us to correction; it is not entertainment. We see the prophecy happening and we love the videos, but your spirit has to be disciplined to ward off the death that comes from still playing in your sins. You cannot stop any of the prophecy going on over there. What we had better be doing is acknowledging it, getting ourselves right in spite of it, and making sure we are on the right side of God’s judgment, knowing the Lord is on his way soon.

“The night is far spent, the day is at hand”: it is high time, meaning high noon, the sun at twelve o’clock in the sky, and you are still sleeping in your sins. You should have been awake.

“Let us therefore cast off the works of darkness”: cast off the works of sin, the thoughts of sin, the practices of sin, thinking that nobody sees you. “And let us put on the armour of light.”

“Not in rioting and drunkenness, not in chambering and wantonness, not in strife and envying.” All of this is going on with the BHIs and with certain brothers and sisters in the congregation, because they still think this is a joke, not realizing the Lord is making his move already, and the Most High’s judgment is going to catch up to them.

“But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ”: that is first and foremost. Put on the commandments.

“And make not provision for the flesh”: don’t give in to what your flesh is aching to do, those impulsive temptations. If you have problems in this area or that area, remove yourself from it. You say you can stand it, you can meddle with this person, this porn, these drugs, this alcohol. You meddle with it and it will bite the hell out of you.

“To fulfil the lusts thereof.” You are paying attention to the lusts while acting like you are all about what’s going on overseas, but in reality you are rotten in your spirit, playing games, and the Most High is going to turn your light on and you will catch hell.

This is the apostle John on the island of Patmos, banished there by the Romans because he was teaching the truth. “So he carried me away in the spirit into the wilderness”, and in the vision he saw Babylon the Great: he basically saw America, and he wondered what in the world this was. No church is breaking this prophecy down.

“A woman sit upon a scarlet coloured beast”: scarlet is red. She, America, sat upon the seven heads of this red beast. “Full of names of blasphemy”: they call themselves Christians and Jews, and they are neither one. You are the Jews, you are the real Christians, you are the Israelites the Bible speaks of. This whole system lies on that and demonizes the true people of God. That is blasphemy, and blasphemy translates into lies. These churches are a witch coven of lies.

“Having seven heads and ten horns”: the seven heads are Greece, Rome, Spain, France, Germany, Russia and Great Britain, and the eighth, which came out of the seven, is America when it got its so-called independence from the British. That is history. The ten horns are the original common market, what is now called NATO. Now there are about thirty of them, trying to break prophecy, but it is talking about them: they all agree to give their power to protect the beast, and that is exactly what the NATO treaty was set up for, to protect the interests of this great beast, America, Babylon the Great.

“And the woman was arrayed in purple and scarlet colour, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls”: decked out with pearls and glamour and diamonds.

“Having a golden cup in her hand full of abominations”: crossdressing is an abomination; women in pants, God calls that an abomination, whatever society says. Two men lying together is an abomination, and two women lying together is an abomination. And when this system condemns the justice that we bring out of the Bible, justifying the wicked and condemning the just, the Lord marks that as an abomination too.

“MYSTERY”: meaning, who is this? Go to the church and ask where Babylon the Great is, and they talk about Iraq. Iraq and Iran are catching hell, but that was ancient Babylon. Babylon the Great today is the United States, decked with pearls and riches and rubies because she robbed everybody, like what they are doing now.

“THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH”: this is lesbian utopia and homosexual paradise. The mother of lies, the mother of harlots, the mother of abominations, and you are in it. All those abominations are greenhoused, fertilized and given the space to grow right here.

“And I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints, and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus.” The martyrs of Jesus are the Israelites, those who stood up for this truth up to the threat of death and beyond it; many of us are going to be killed. Babylon the Great, America, drank our blood: she killed us, murdered us, put us in captivity and dealt evil with us.

“And when I saw her, I wondered with great admiration.” John is seeing in the vision what is happening to us, there on the island of Patmos where he was banished.

“And the angel said unto me, Wherefore didst thou marvel?” The angel came to him: John, why are you marvelling? I know I showed you some heavy things, but lean back. “I will tell thee the mystery of the woman, and of the beast that carrieth her, which hath the seven heads and ten horns.” America is riding off the power of the seven heads and the ten horns. That is the beast she rides upon, because she is the eighth part of that beast.

“The beast that thou sawest was, and is not”: the beast was in your vision, John, but it is not in your time; it is not ruling yet.

“And shall ascend out of the bottomless pit”: when this eighth head comes up, it comes out of Europe, Great Britain to be exact. The bottomless pit means very little resources: no matter how much you dig, you get no real resources. That is the exact reason she has such an insatiable appetite to rob, robbing for oil, cocoa, coffee, diamonds and gold, because they themselves do not have that abundance.

“And go into perdition”: it shall be destroyed. That is where we are now; the war is signifying exactly what we are reading. The weapons to do it are already here. The Lord will come with fire, literally riding on the weapons being fired, with some two hundred million angels, to destroy the whole land. That is the perdition of Babylon the Great.

“And they that dwell on the earth shall wonder, whose names were not written in the book of life from the foundation of the world”: these people are going to be destroyed. They are not getting into the kingdom at all; the book of life is for the Israelites. It goes a step further too: America was not in physical existence at that time. The Lord doesn’t care how many churches they set up; it doesn’t mean a thing. Think about the Lord’s Prayer: thy kingdom come, thy will be done. There is a kingdom in existence right now. Christ is not coming back to set his kingdom beside this one; the King of kings and Lord of lords is coming to topple it. Every time you say the Lord’s Prayer you are advocating for the destruction of this kingdom.

“When they behold the beast that was, and is not, and yet is.” To behold is to look. When the people see this beast that is here now, they still don’t recognize it is Babylon the Great; they ask where Babylon the Great is while standing in it. “Was”: it was in your vision, John. “Is not”: it is not in your time yet. “And yet is”: but it is coming, and we are living in it now. When the people see it for what it really is, after they have been taught by the prophets, they will know. That is why they are going to hate us so much, because we make it clear to the people. We are obligated by God to teach it the way it is written.

“And here is the mind which hath wisdom”: the mind that studies the Bible. “The seven heads are seven mountains”: it explains itself, and the churches purposely leave it out. Seven mountains means governments, kings, “on which the woman sitteth”: the woman, Babylon the Great, America, rides on them.

“And there are seven kings: five are fallen, and one is”: the one that is, is Rome, the one John was in. All the rest were overthrown by Rome, which was ruling all of them at this point, and that is the one that put him on a damn island.

“And the other is not yet come”: that is Great Britain. “And when he cometh, he must continue a short space.” They used to say the sun never sets on the empire of Great Britain. The Most High broke that up when he caused the war of independence, and that was the end of that, and America was set up.

“And the beast that was, and is not, even he is the eighth, and is of the seven”: America is of Great Britain and the rest of the seven heads. That is history. The preachers who don’t bring this out may not know it, but the ones behind the lies know exactly what it is talking about, and they make sure it isn’t taught so they keep their tax breaks; those big churches are financed to keep those lies going. “And goeth into perdition.”

“And the ten horns which thou sawest are ten kings, which have received no kingdom as yet”: that was the formation of NATO, set up around 1945. “But receive power as kings one hour with the beast.” Now they have added some twenty more, about thirty, trying to break prophecy, but we know it is talking about them.

precepts.why:
“Drunken with the blood of the saints”: Obadiah explains what that means. “For the day of the Lord is near upon all the heathen”: the heathen are all the nations. “As thou hast done, it shall be done unto thee: thy reward shall return upon thine own head.” The reward of what they did to us is coming back on all the nations.

“For as ye have drunk upon my holy mountain”: what did they drink upon us? Captivity, slavery, rape, robbery, murder, lies, rigged juries, castrations, lynchings, being railroaded. As they have done all these evils to us, these things will be done back to them: “so shall all the heathen drink continually.” Every nation that did this to his people will drink that captivity continually. “Yea, they shall drink, and they shall swallow down”: they will digest it. They will drink the slavery, the castrations, getting their backs whipped, getting lynched, all of it.

“And they shall be as though they had not been.” They will be as though they were never a nation in the first place; they are all going into slavery. Doesn’t that sound familiar? They dehumanized us to the point that we don’t even recognize we were once a great people, reduced us to nothing, when we are the jewels of God. So they will be reduced to nothing, their name cut off, because that is what they did to us.

“But upon mount Zion shall be deliverance”: for the ones of us that repent and stop BSing. The ones that don’t repent and continue the BS, the Most High is going to wipe out along with our enemies. So when John sees Babylon drunk with our blood, this is what is coming back upon her head.

sense.text:
“And the dragon was wroth with the woman”: the dragon is this great red beast, the scarlet coloured beast, Babylon the Great, Esau, the power causing hell all over the planet earth. He was angry with the woman, and the woman is the nation of Israel; the top of the twelfth chapter shows her with a crown of twelve stars, the twelve tribes of Israel.

“And went to make war with the remnant of her seed”: the remnant of the seed of the twelve tribes is who this government, Babylon the Great, is going to come against. Who will they come after? Those “which keep the commandments of God, and have the testimony of Jesus Christ.” Those are the ones the Most High is going to protect, so that is the side you want to be on.

So those of us not keeping the commandments of God are going to find ourselves in huge judgment by God. You worry about what America and the other nations will do to us for keeping the commandments; you had better be on that side rather than let this truth go and have the Lord destroy you. It is a terrible and dreadful thing to fall into the hands of the living power: the Most High can destroy your body and put your spirit in hell. Esau can’t do that. Kill my body all you want, you are not getting my spirit; you kill me, I’m coming back to hang your ass. That is how you have to think. And some of those who will fall are sitting in these congregations BSing. They had better get themselves right.

“For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal”: we put more emphasis on the physical war overseas and don’t think about the spiritual war we need to fight within ourselves. The Lord isn’t asking you to do anything out there. He is asking you to get your mind right and change your behavior. You are at war right now, brothers and sisters, in your spirit, with all the evil temptations pushed out on all fronts: family, school, work, everywhere you go, even the evil thoughts flowing through your mind as you sit here. That is the war you are fighting.

This is not about picking up guns. It is about getting the weapons in your mind to fight evil temptation. That said, if anyone comes at you with a rope or a knife and you have the means to protect yourself, make sure they don’t get the chance to use it on anybody else; no one should allow themselves to be lynched or murdered. But we do not advocate any of us going out and initiating aggression toward anybody. Some take the words of the Most High, go off and do something crazy, then blame us. We are not advocating that at all. Get your mind right. A lot of these brothers can’t even discipline their food: horrible eating habits, no exercise, can’t run ten steps. Burn the fat.

The weapons are the commandments of God. You are supposed to answer your impulses, your sinful temptations, with the commandments of God; that is what keeps you from going through that door of temptation. “But mighty through God”: these commandments are mighty. “To the pulling down of strong holds”: mighty to pull down lies. We open the Bible and swallow up the lies and get rid of those impulsive sinful thoughts. If you understood there was death around the corner you would listen to these laws, but because judgment is not immediate, the wicked man’s mind is emboldened to commit evil and leave the commandments to the side.

“Casting down imaginations”: casting down lies. “And every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God”: every lie that exalts itself against the Bible. The knowledge of God is the law, the Bible.

“And bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ”: bring all thoughts, every idea, under the obedience of this Bible.

“And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience.” Some of our people can’t wait: they want to be in the war on the streets, casting out demons, getting their name on the Saturday night specials, getting the good camera angle so their video goes up. But here is the stipulation: “when your obedience is fulfilled.” That means you have no impediments in your spirit to commit sin; you let the commandments make you walk straight in your spirit, in your household, with your children, all around you, so that you are blameless. Then you can go out and correct your people.

We want to play warrior, but not war for the obedience to Christ; we want to look good while we have demons all up in us. Look how bad it is: a ranking brother in the body re-enlisted after war was announced over there, as if he didn’t know prophecy. There is a time and a season for all things, and if you know the time you are supposed to operate by the knowledge of the times. When Christ comes back to fight against our enemies, you would be in the armies told to go and fight against Christ. Meanwhile a young woman in the world, who joined because she couldn’t find a job, took the signing bonus and now regrets it, is trying to get out. They keep our people poor and put recruiting stations in all the black cities, like Planned Parenthood, so we put our bodies on the field to be all we could never be in America, fighting for their cause to keep oppressing the rest of our people. It is a trick bag.

And a woman in the world had enough sense not to get entangled when a BHI brother tried to post up on her; she saw he broke character, Bible in hand. Meanwhile sisters in the body get played by brothers like that. People in the world have better sense than some of us in this truth. Our spirits aren’t right.

precepts.why:
“When your obedience is fulfilled” is what Ezra is told: “Now therefore set thine house in order, and reprove thy people.” You have to first set your house in order. Your physical house can’t be set in order if your spiritual house, meaning your damn head, is not in order.

You haven’t even checked your own self yet, your own wicked thoughts, your own actions, your own temptations, and you are trying to correct the wife, the son and the daughter while your head is still messed up. Correct that first. Set your head in order; when your head is in order you can set your house in order, “and reprove thy people.”

That is when your obedience is fulfilled. Now you can go out and revenge all disobedience, because you have first checked it within your own self.

sense.text:
Divine orchestration means orchestrated by God. God controls everything. “Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done, saying, My counsel shall stand”: God said his counsel is going to stand. “And I will do all my pleasure”: all means everything. However the Most High orchestrates what happens on this planet earth, God set it up that way, and he directs the purpose of what is happening.

That includes the people we encounter and end up regretting meeting: people who did you wrong, betrayed you, the whole nine. If God is truly the divine orchestrator, he sent that to you. We feel bad about it and miss the importance of the encounter. We let ourselves get close to people, they bite us, and then we chastise ourselves: why me? What was it about me that emboldened this person to do this evil to me? Why did God allow it?

Betrayal is the absolute worst thing that can happen. But why did God allow it? Remember, he declared the end from the beginning. The Lord allows these things because he is trying to teach the elect of the Israelites something.

“A wicked woman is given as a portion to a wicked man.” Ask yourself why. It is to show you a reflection of yourself. God orchestrated that woman to come into your life to show you exactly who you are: your woman is your reflection. The Lord gives you that to show you what you are really dealing with inside. Forget the bombs; let the bomb go off in your head.

“But a godly woman is given to him that feareth the Lord”: a godly man will have a woman that reflects his godliness. To the wicked one the Lord sends the wicked woman. Who gave it? The Most High. It is that woman you gave me, Adam said; that was to bring out an impediment in his obedience.

So a man complains of a wicked woman, yet claims he is not wicked in his words and in his compliant deeds of following her. If that is true, he will escape from her. This is about women in the world and about backdoor marriages: when you don’t start it off right, it ends up wrong.

precepts.why:
“And I find more bitter than death the woman”: not all women. The kind of woman worse than death is the one who does all that the rest of the verse says. What could be worse than death? Some brothers are living in it: driving home from a hard day’s work, sitting in the driveway with a hot beer, afraid to touch the doorknob because of what is behind that door, going through eight scenarios in five steps.

“Whose heart is snares and nets”: she uses her mind to trap you from doing the work of the Lord, creating situations to keep you from keeping the laws of the Most High, creating chaos so you can’t be with the brothers, can’t go to camp, can’t come to the meetings, giving you assignments so you can’t move. “And her hands as bands”: her hands are traps and cages to henpeck your head.

“Whoso pleaseth God shall escape from her; but the sinner shall be taken by her.” The sinner will be destroyed by her, because she is indeed his portion, and he was meant to receive that. That is divine orchestration: some are not made to make it in this truth. You will encounter different things, and if your spirit is not properly girded up you will be taken by one of these temptations and destroyed. So if a man lets himself be destroyed, he was indeed wicked, and the woman sent to him was his portion for real. This is for all of us, brothers and sisters alike.

Here is the man in the world who is trying to repent, claiming he is not wicked, with a wicked woman on him; and it goes both ways, men too. She keeps up the snares and the bands of Ecclesiastes 7:26, and whoso pleaseth God shall escape from that kind of woman, while the sinner is taken by her.

So he is trying to get his house in order and straighten it out, and she won’t listen: “If she go not as thou wouldest have her, cut her off from thy flesh, and give her a bill of divorce, and let her go.”

This is not talking about a biblical marriage. Once you are married in this truth, she is yours for life unless she commits adultery, and there is no divorce in the Bible. This is for those on the outside of this truth who come in with all kinds of situations going on.

sense.text:
“But if the unbelieving depart, let him depart.” This is the man trying to change: he was a wicked man and he inherited a wicked woman. Why? To see if he will stay there. God orchestrated that, to reflect what is in us so we can change. The elect is what the Lord is interested in, so he puts us through trials and temptations, and the question is whether we will overcome them.

“A brother or a sister is not under bondage in such cases”: the bondage is worldly marriage. We do not dissolve marriages in here; it is written in our rules, and biblically we are not doing that. This is for the one who is in the world, trying to repent and come into the truth, whose spouse says, I don’t care what you do, I don’t want anything to do with that Bible, and they are not bending: still cooking pork on one side of the stove, chitlins and hog maws, telling you that half is for you since you keep them laws.

“But God hath called us to peace.” In those bad worldly marriages where the spouse says, I am not following that Bible, whoso pleaseth God shall escape from that situation, like Ecclesiastes and Ecclesiasticus say.

Brothers and sisters coming in from these situations have a lot of work to do before they can even think about properly marrying, and some are impatient and jump on things. Your leadership are the fathers of the men and women; we have the records. When we tell you to lean back, wait and let the brother or the sister work on themselves, it is for a good reason, because the backdoor marriage stories are horrible and get worse every time.

A sister once asked at Passover when she could walk away from the husband she had been with for ten years, who had been through Africanism, Islam and other things. In his mind this truth may be just another fad. Practice what 1 Peter 3 says, go home and see; the timetable is up to the Lord. You will know when it is proper, and not because your hormones are burning. They have been with you through all your craziness for years; they want to see whether this new thing is real. We have plenty of examples, on the women’s side and the men’s side, where it proved real and the spouse came in and they are with us to this day.

precepts.why:
Here is the case where the sister repented but the husband has not. “Likewise, ye wives, be in subjection to your own husbands”: still deal with your husband rightly, even though he is in the world. You have been together ten years in fornication, whatever, and now you come in and learn the commandments. Men do this too: last week he was all in the sin with her, now he comes home tearing the house upside down, and she says, you didn’t talk this way last week; give me a chance to see if you are really about this. Some want to cast a woman off and come in looking for a new sister. Sisters, leave those men alone and let them get themselves right.

He isn’t telling you to sell your behind or do anything wicked; he is worldly, but he is not telling you to break the laws of God. Don’t be trying to cut him off. “That, if any obey not the word”: if any of the husbands obey not the Bible, because they don’t understand it yet, “they also may without the word be won by the conversation of the wives.” They may be won by the righteous conversation she gives him. He doesn’t know much about this Bible, but he sees the change in her: I need to find out about this truth, because it changed you, and I like what I see. We have had that happen many times.

“While they behold your chaste conversation”: chaste means with discipline, with chastity; there is discipline in your speech. You are not cursing him out; you are dealing with him righteously, putting on the proper clothing and explaining why. She would tell him: I want you to come in and take command, take your rightful place, so I can deal with you as a proper wife. If he is indeed righteous, he will come in behind her. If he decides not to, let him go.

“Coupled with fear”: he notices not only how she speaks, but that she has a fear of the Lord. It is serious, not a fad, not a phase. It works the other way too: brothers repented while their wives gave them hell, and the wife said, I didn’t know he was this serious, he was willing to let me go. If this man loves his truth this much, I want to love it the way he does. That is the Most High giving righteousness to righteousness.

“Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning”: it isn’t just the clothing. “But let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.” All of a sudden he has a wife who isn’t yelling at him. He comes home from catching hell at work and she knows how to pull him out of it with a soft answer. Where are you learning all this wisdom? Then you tell him, and in that case the husband will come right on in.

Back to the sister: “If she go not as thou wouldest have her, cut her off from thy flesh, and give her a bill of divorce, and let her go.” That is worldly. If he or she is not trying to do right, let them go, or you will be taken; the sinner is taken by these wicked spirits.

That was a test. If you were really meant to be righteous and obtain the kingdom, you will go through things like this, and whatever temptation is sent your way, you will find the way to escape.

sense.text: This is in the wilderness, when the commandments, the tables and the statutes were given to Moses. “The Lord, The Lord God, merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in goodness and truth”: that is the Lord we serve. We need to trust that the Lord has our back when we are trying to do the right thing.

Why read this? Because every time we come back on this earth, we need to look back into our history and find out why we are in the mess we are in now. Once we realize we messed up and repent, we need to change how we are in this lifetime, and not let more temptations send us back in the wicked direction.

“Keeping mercy for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin”: he will pardon our transgressions and our sins. “And that will by no means clear the guilty”: if we are guilty of breaking God’s laws, we pay. We are still keeping the same bad habits we had in the past, and still getting the same problems over and over. When you don’t learn the lesson, the ultimate judgment comes.

“Visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children”: visiting the sins of what we did in the past. Yes, we were back there. When Moses told Israel in the wilderness that the Lord would bring them into Egypt again with ships if they broke these commandments, he said you, not your children or your great-grandchildren. The people standing in front of Moses did not go into captivity on ships in their physical bodies; their spirits came back generations later and went into that captivity. It was us that Moses was speaking to, and it was us that went on the slave ships. The yokes of iron were not put on our necks in the wilderness; that came in the 1600s, 1700s and 1800s, generation after generation still messing up.

A lot of us did not learn from the mistakes we made back then; we came back and did the same thing. Still wicked, still evil, still covetous to this day. We haven’t learned a thing, and the Most High will keep sending those afflictions. We should learn not to carry the same BS from way back then up to now. Those who are not serious, the Lord will send temptations to see where your mind really is.

“And Moses made haste, and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshipped.” “For it is a stiffnecked people”: we were stiffnecked back then, and the same stiffnecked brothers are coming up today doing the same thing. Hopefully we learn from the mistakes of our past lives and past generations. If you don’t know what you did in the past, read the Bible, the book of your fathers, find out what your people did and why all this hell is coming upon us, and you will know what not to do today.

“And pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for thine inheritance.” We want the Lord to pardon our sins and keep mercy for thousands, and take us for his inheritance; that is what we are trying to get back to. Our Creator created a way for the elect to escape. The 144,000 are men; the elect is men and women. Make sure you are the elect that won’t be pulled off your game by slick talk: read your Bible and study.

precepts.why:
“Of them that hate me”: the other place the commandments say it shows what that means. “Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I the Lord thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me.”

To disobey God’s commandments is to demonstrate that you hate God. That is why the iniquity is visited on the generations: they keep carrying on the same disobedience.

The same BS we did back then, we still do today. “Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour’s house, thou shalt not covet thy neighbour’s wife, nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his ass”: to covet means to take what doesn’t belong to you, by wickedness, by deceit.

“Nor any thing that is thy neighbour’s”: you are not to covet or take anything that belongs to that father, that neighbour. Notice “nor his ox”: that leads to Exodus 22.

Exodus 22 is the same chapter some use to beguile sisters, and that whole chapter is about putting restraints on covetousness. That law is proper because it was put in place for those who wanted to do evil.

“If a man shall steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it, or sell it; he shall restore five oxen for an ox.” You coveted your neighbour’s ox, which Exodus 20 forbids; if you do, you pay it back five times over. It is like a speeding ticket: the ticket and the insurance going up are the consequence of breaking the original law. Drive the speed limit.

“And if a man entice a maid that is not betrothed”: the maid belongs to the father. To entice her means you coveted to get her, behind the father’s back, in deceit. You broke the tenth commandment, “nor any thing that is thy neighbour’s”; that daughter is, if you will, the property of that father, and you lured her away from him. Don’t tell me that is righteous. A woman with no wisdom will follow that and pay for the judgment.

The next verse kills it: the father can refuse; although you enticed her, you are not taking her. That is what happened with Dinah. She was enticed, spoken to sweetly, not raped, and even though he later wanted to marry her, they snatched her out of that house, and she had to sit there defiled. Better that than to destroy herself by going along with it.

That is a warning to you women. We are not approving backdoor marriages, period. If we have to snatch you out to keep you from getting caught up, it is better to sit here with that scarlet letter than to be tied to somebody who means you pure evil. How could you respect a man who went behind your father’s back, behind your protection? Some women know they are going against scripture and say, I’m going with it anyway: that was your temptation to draw you out, and that was your portion.

sense.text: This chapter repeats what we just read in Exodus: the first verses tell how we were under the cloud with Moses in the wilderness and how wicked we were back then, and the Israelites in Corinth were doing the same thing, so they had to be reminded. “And did all drink the same spiritual drink”: it was our fathers under that cloud. “For they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them: and that Rock was Christ.” Christ was in those commandments, in all of what Moses gave us. Moses spoke of Christ, which is why Christ later said that if they had believed Moses they would have believed him, for Moses wrote of him.

“But with many of them God was not well pleased: for they were overthrown in the wilderness.” You don’t want to be overthrown in this wilderness here, when Christ comes back. This is the Passover season we are in now; you don’t know what may happen.

“Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things, as they also lusted.” These things happened when our forefathers messed up, and we are not to fall into the same. The same covetousness we had back then, we are still practicing today.

“The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play”: to play in sin, adultery, all types of evil and wickedness in the wilderness, until the Most High opened up the ground and swallowed tens of thousands of them all at once, and the ground closed up on them and scared everybody.

“Neither let us commit fornication, as some of them committed, and fell in one day three and twenty thousand.” That was the deal back then, and you still have us doing it today, trying to disguise it as something righteous. You have no fear of the Lord and no fear of the judgment. If you think we are stupid, you think God is stupid, and you will pay for that. If any of us is in this kind of sin, you should be scared to death: death can come at any time. You don’t know what the Lord might do, a bird hitting the windshield and you go in the river.

“Neither let us tempt Christ, as some of them also tempted, and were destroyed of serpents”: that is in the book of Numbers. “Neither murmur ye, as some of them also murmured, and were destroyed of the destroyer.”

“And they are written for our admonition”: this is written for us to do right today. But how will you be tested? The Most High sends those encounters to see where your head is at: the divine orchestration and purpose of the people you encounter. Those who fail to learn from the mistakes of history are doomed to repeat them. You read it in the Bible and still don’t learn, so you repeat it, and the same spirits come and attach themselves to you.

How many have moved from one town to another, or left a job, because they couldn’t get along with the people, only to find the same problem in the new city? Because you never corrected what was wrong with you, the Lord sent the same spirits everywhere you went to show you your mirror. A wicked woman is given as a portion to a wicked man: if you don’t change, you will keep getting those reflectors of you, and that is where the betrayals come in. We get betrayals too, but we are not deceived: we go to the Bible, the Most High casts the wicked out, and the Lord says, well done, my servants; inherit five and ten cities.

There must be heresies to try you, and they latch on to certain spirits. A sister who comes in with a nasty gossiping habit won’t latch on to the senior sisters whose spiritual game is in order; she goes to the simple sisters, where those spirits can rest comfortably and not be chastised. People move from congregation to congregation for spiritual growth and the same thing happens again. The requirement is on you; the discipline is on you.

“Upon whom the ends of the world are come. Wherefore let him that thinketh he standeth take heed lest he fall.” Pay attention to your own spirit. Examine yourselves and ask: why do these things keep happening to me? Is it something I am doing?

No temptation should derail us from inheriting the wide, the kingdom we are trying to get back to, set in a wide place with a narrow passage to get to it, because his mercy endures forever. We are in a trial every day, but the Lord has mercy on us and lets us use his Bible as spiritual weapons to fight off evil temptation, and he gives us the keys to get there.

“The sun to rule by day: for his mercy endureth for ever.” “The moon and stars to rule by night.” That is the Lord declaring the end from the beginning. He created all of this; we acknowledge his greatness and his mercy, and we tap into that comfort under the shadow of his mercy.

“To him that smote Egypt in their firstborn: for his mercy endureth for ever.” The Most High killed our enemies for us because he had mercy on us. We cried in Egypt and the Lord heard our cries: go down, Moses, tell Pharaoh to let my people go, and if he doesn’t, I will kill his firstborn, because his mercies endure forever for us.

“And brought out Israel from among them”, “With a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm”, “To him which divided the Red sea into parts”, “And made Israel to pass through the midst of it”, “But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea.” We saw all of this, and we still get here today and still do evil.

“To him which led his people through the wilderness”, “To him which smote great kings: for his mercy endureth for ever.” The Most High is trying to set us back up, but he wants to make sure we are in the right spiritual posture to inherit the kingdom.

“My soul hath them still in remembrance, and is humbled in me.” Them is the afflictions and punishments we are supposed to remember for breaking God’s commandments in the past, and we are humbled because of it.

“This I recall to my mind, therefore have I hope. It is of the Lord’s mercies that we are not consumed”: that is the love the Lord has for us, his mercy enduring forever. “Because his compassions fail not”: he loves you sisters, he loves you brothers. “They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.” His mercies are renewed every day, forgiving us. We say the Lord’s Prayer, ask the Lord for mercy and forgiveness of our transgressions, and he does it, and we are still playing with sin.
“The Lord is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.” Now we are in the posture where he has given us a way to escape from the evil all around us.

“Thou preparest a table before me”: the Lord prepared a table in the presence of our enemies while we endure the encounters of temptation that are common to us all, even the temptations of our own lusts. Why? Because his mercies endure forever. Listen to how it is written: the table he prepared is the Bible.

precepts.why:
Since we are talking about tables: “And the Lord answered me, and said, Write the vision”. This is the Lord telling the prophet Habakkuk: since you want to get out of captivity, write the vision down, “and make it plain upon tables.” The tables are the Bible, and that is what we are supposed to be reading.

We read the tables and talk about what is going on overseas while our own spirit is rotten, reading it like entertainment instead of changing what is really going on in us.

“That he may run that readeth it.” When we bring this out, everybody is going to be running, and we are going to run to teach it. The Bible is going to turn this whole system upside down, like those who turned the world upside down, but we have to be in it like that.

“Now go, write it before them in a table”: this is to the wicked Israelites, us, our people. The tables again. “And note it in a book”: put a note in the Bible about their wickedness, about our wickedness. “That it may be for the time to come for ever and ever”: the Bible is for the time to come, today.

Brothers and sisters, you are in the greatest place on the planet earth and some don’t even realize it: you are getting teaching that tells you what is happening in the future, because we read the Bible, and you are still taking it for a joke and scorning it.

“That this is a rebellious people.” That is what is going on with our people; our people are rebellious as hell. But the Bible is here to correct you and straighten you out. If you want it, there is a way for you to get it.

sense.text:
“There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able.” The Most High will not put more on you, because you are his elect. If you understood the joy of the elect, you would embrace the temptation, hard as that is to say. You won’t run from it; you will endure, because you know the Lord has your back. You go through the trial and the straits; enter ye in at the strait gate, and you still enter.

He will not put more on you than you can handle, because you are in fact the righteous. He wants you to make it and doesn’t want any of us to perish, though some are appointed to die. So when those people encounter you, you that are part of the elect, men and women, recognize what you are dealing with: the Lord is trying to show you something in you so you can fix it, and then you don’t have to deal with that trial anymore.

Way back in the beginning in Brooklyn, the landlord saw the brothers and sisters coming in, stood across the street counting heads, and jacked the rent from about $650 to $1,400 within weeks. The leadership had been paying that rent out of their own jobs, not charging the congregation. We had gotten comfortable in that little space, but the Lord sent that affliction to wake us up and force us to look at areas within ourselves we weren’t ready to look at. We had to come out of the comfort zone and work together: Deacon Yeshua understood real estate, Barnabas carpentry, others sheetrock, plumbing, electrical. Meanwhile, with the congregation unable to gather, all kinds of evil started happening, fornication and more, which is why the sanctuaries matter: they keep the fetters on us. We grew as a result of that trial, and then came the building in New York, and the detractors and scoffers. We went to the Bible, leaned on the Lord, and got the building anyway.

Those trials were reflections of our fear and our doubt, put in our face by the Lord: are you going to succumb and be taken by it, or understand it is a trial to overcome and become better? Even the madness in Brooklyn was not more than we could handle. The Lord said, I see you have faith, Bishop Nathanyel, Yawasap, Canai, you deacons, you captains; now let me bless you and see how you grow. There were trials at every step, but we never took our eyes off the prize. Don’t let anybody take your crown; there is a place for you in this kingdom.

“But will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.”

The gift of life is for us to enjoy, and the Lord did not waste his time. This is how special you are, you men and you women. You cannot allow the reflections of your bad decisions, your sins, your doubts and your fears to rule you, because the Lord will send temptations to pull that out of you. Why would a brother or a sister do you wrong? To show you how to guard yourself so it doesn’t happen again. That is to build you up.

“Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee”: before the sperm hit the egg, before you were formed in your mother’s womb, I, the supreme being, Yahawah, God, knew you as an individual. He is talking to Jeremiah here, but you are just as special as Jeremiah, men and women.

“And before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations.” He did that for the man he was speaking to, Jeremiah, but he also did it for you women: you have a divine purpose. How dare you let somebody take you off that divine purpose in righteousness, playing in your sins, your lust and your doubts, and destroy yourselves.

The gift of life is for us to enjoy by the manual the Lord made for us, and the manual is the Bible. He created us, and this is what we are supposed to live by; that was God’s plan on this earth from the beginning. When the Pharisees threw at Christ the law Moses gave about putting away wives, Christ had to tell them that from the beginning it was not so. Because of their covetousness and treacherous dealing with women, Moses had to put some fetters around their wicked ways, provisions to keep them from going totally wild. But in the beginning it was never supposed to be like that, and that is what we want to get back to: not whoredom, not treacherous dealing with our women, but the beginning, how Christ and the Most High meant it to be.

“The sea is set in a wide place, that it might be deep and great”: this is the wide, the kingdom we want to get back to. “But put the case the entrance were narrow, and like a river.”

“Who then could go into the sea to look upon it, and to rule it? if he went not through the narrow”: the narrow is because of your own lusts, your own temptations, your own inability to let those bad habits go. So the Lord has to send you spirits to show you how wicked you are, your fear and your doubt, to manifest those demons out of you. Hopefully you say, I understand this was a trial; I repent; thank you for the reminder; now I will walk straight. But some of us stay in it, fall, and go to hell with it.

The Lord wants to purge those demons and evil spirits from us, so he sends those people, the ones you encounter, as a reflection of the nastiness still in you. Once you recognize it and say, I’m not going for this, there is no need to send that kind of spirit again. But if you never learn, no matter what town or congregation you move to, the same spirits will find you, because you have not learned your lesson. “How could he come into the broad?”

“A city is builded, and set upon a broad field, and is full of all good things: The entrance thereof is narrow, and is set in a dangerous place to fall, like as if there were a fire on the right”: that is what it will take for us to make it. The fire and the water are your temptations, your impediments, the things knocking brothers into the water and sisters into the fire. You have to endure it all because it is literally your thing: nobody else can go through it but you, because everybody’s sins are unique to them. You must overcome your own lust, temptations, doubts and fears; until you overcome that, you can’t get the kingdom.

That is the divine orchestration and purpose of the people you encounter. Why did the Lord send me this bad person? Because of you. Why did he allow this to happen to me? Because of something in you. Are you going to pass the test or fall? We must have the consequences of our sins reflected back to our conscience; those people are sent our way by God to make us look at the life we are living as opposed to the life God meant for us from the very beginning. If we keep messing up we haven’t learned the lesson yet, and if we continue not to learn, then comes the ultimate judgment, damnation.

It is like speeding: you get a ticket, your insurance goes up, and you ignore the fetters that restrain you. Then you speed until you kill someone and you are in jail. One man filmed himself doing 154 miles an hour, surely after many tickets, drove straight into the sun so he couldn’t see, smashed into a tree and survived with serious injuries, maybe able to move nothing but his head: a spirit trapped in a body that can’t move, like a spirit in hell. Another car on the traffic cameras: the passenger died instantly. That is what happens when we ignore the warnings, and the ultimate judgment is the lake of fire.

These people bring spirits, and heresies latch on to certain people and not others because of what is still in us to be purged. The laws give you a way to escape: when you hear that heresy you stand up and say, this brother or this sister is bringing evil in the congregation, and you passed. If you get caught up in it, you bear the same sin as the ones bringing the offense.
